scope: Single-site snapshot; sample-level characteristics and repeated retention measurements. No time-trend or causal claim.

interpretation.density: Unresolved unit conflict: documentation says g m^-3 but values are near 1. Exclude density-derived calculations; do not silently substitute g cm^-3.
interpretation.conductivity: Flag 1 is documented as suspect/use with caution. Exclude conductivity comparisons from P05; do not transfer this flag automatically to retention.
interpretation.retention: Vol_Water is documented as percent. MPa_Abs holds positive magnitudes; make the pressure-sign convention explicit and obtain soil-science review.
interpretation.sampling: Rows within a retention curve are repeated measurements, not independent field samples; row-weighted averaging across curves is not justified.
interpretation.limits: No calibration, laboratory protocol, representativeness or instrument-error audit performed. No model fit or inferred field-capacity/wilting-point values.
